zimmermann.name: Zimmermann
zimmermann.html:
Zimmermann was a mage who completed thirteen Sleep raids and twenty Dusk raids from June through December 2020. He stayed through Dusk's first guild-only Naxxramas night. Fourteen recorded awards include Mana Igniting Cord and the Molten Core pieces that built his early set.

Two reports predate the local tenure and one overlaps it. No later activity has been found after the final Dusk appearance.

zwift.name: Zwift
zwift.html:
Zwift was a rogue with fourteen Sleep raids and one Dusk appearance in the summer of 2020. His three documented awards include Bloodfang Boots and the Head of Nefarian.

Forty-eight outside reports predate his local arrival, evidence of a substantial earlier raid history whose context remains unresolved. Ten later reports continue from August through October without identifying another guild.

zyaya.name: Zyaya
zyaya.html:
Zyaya was a rogue who entered during Dusk's Ahn'Qiraj season and continued into Ascension. Eighteen Dusk raids and seventeen Ascension raids form the guild record, with three additional personal PUGs. He was present for Dusk's first guild-only Naxxramas night and received eight documented awards, including Dragonfang Blade and Huhuran's Stinger.

Nine reports predate his local tenure and twenty-three outside reports overlap it through March 2021. None falls after the final local appearance, so the evidence shows parallel activity rather than a later destination.

òllz.name: Òllz
òllz.html:
Òllz hunted for 47 raids between 13 February and 24 September 2020, 42 with Ninjas and five after the Dusk merger, and was present for the 9/9 Ahn'Qiraj clear on 3 September.

He also did quiet Discord administration for the officer team, adjusting channel permissions and roles between raids, and had opinions on loot fairness beyond his own class: in May 2020 he argued that a contested drop should simply have gone to whichever warlocks and mages needed it, regardless of who had raised the complaint. He was a good sport about his own class's turn in the rotation too, joking when Drake Fang Talisman priority came up for hunters that he'd "like to see some people cry." Eight outside reports predate his run, 30 overlap it, and seven more continue from November 2020 through April 2021. A contemporary officer message said Òllz was an officer in Decimation and bringing the departing group there; two reports from one later date match Decimation's historical guild feed, showing that he raided with them.

nittedal.name: Artimis
nittedal.who: Guild Master through the Sleep era and the reason the rest of the circle ended up on Razorgore.

nittedal.name: Deliz
nittedal.who: Healer and the circle's first player; his February 2020 exit over healer treatment was the story's first fairness fight.

nittedal.name: Supplier
nittedal.who: The consumables economy in human form; healing officer; curator of the Dusk tribute-video list.

nittedal.name: Glorya
nittedal.who: Priest healer with near-perfect attendance, recruited into the post-Deliz healer gap; healed the first Four Horsemen kill.

nittedal.name: Galidia
nittedal.who: Warrior; an early Bracelets of Wrath recipient whose friendship with Artimis continued long after the guild.

nittedal.name: Zhèna
nittedal.who: Warrior who stepped up as temporary main tank in the post-Kugel gap and held a place in the Thunderfury binding queue.

nittedal.name: Pnats
nittedal.who: Druid healer and Dusk officer; Ragie's brother; wrote the era's epitaph the night Dusk dissolved.

nittedal.name: Ragie
nittedal.who: Tank leader across all three guilds; Pnats's brother; the main-tank half of the guild's longest loot argument.

nittedal.name: Fnats
nittedal.who: Early Sleep restoration druid from the home crew; his friendship with Artimis spans from 2019 to long after the guild.

nittedal.name: Neptun
nittedal.who: Ragie's girlfriend; mage in the first Four Horsemen kill and the December core.

nittedal.name: Exclus
nittedal.who: Mage main; his paladin alt Exclusafk was temporary class leader from 15–22 April 2020.

nittedal.name: Panadin
nittedal.who: Paladin; Eye of Sulfuras contender who yielded first place to Thepaladin and stayed part of the group's game nights.
